description: Compatible family with 02-02 latent dose; grid describes local ROI rather than whole substrate. A developer must process only ROI or explicitly handle missing area.

grid.integration: hard contact: exact polygon area and circular aperture intersection; proximity: analytic Gaussian integration or edge-aware adaptive slice quadrature

exposure.peakDoseMjCm2: Nominal incident dose I*t, not necessarily the maximum cell average

statistics.equivalentClearAreaMm2: Integrated dose divided by incident dose
